version.changelog:
Initial public release — universal AI-powered web scraping skill for 55+ platforms.

- Scrape data from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Google Maps, Google Search, Google Trends, Booking.com, and TripAdvisor.
- Automatically selects the best Apify Actor for any data extraction use case.
- Supports lead generation, influencer discovery, brand monitoring, competitor analysis, review analysis, trend research, and more.
- Provides a step-by-step workflow, strict input validation, and clear multi-actor workflow examples.
- Easily extensible: fallback to search for additional actors in Apify Store if needed.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements, instructions, and code are internally consistent with a tool that runs Apify actors using an APIFY_TOKEN and a small helper CLI; nothing in the bundle indicates clear misdirection or unrelated privilege requests.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (universal Apify-based scraper) match what the code and SKILL.md do: select an Apify Actor, start a run via api.apify.com, poll status, and download dataset items. Required APIFY_TOKEN and node/mcporter are plausible for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md gives precise workflow steps and input-sanitization rules and instructs only on selecting actors, fetching schemas (via mcporter), running actors, and exporting results. The bundled run_actor.js performs API calls to api.apify.com and writes output files restricted to the current working directory; it does not instruct reading unrelated local config files or unrelated environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install spec installs an npm package called 'mcporter' (creates a mcporter binary). Installing an npm CLI is reasonable for fetching actor schemas, but installing arbitrary npm packages has supply-chain risk (no version pinned in metadata). Recommend verifying the mcporter package's origin and version before auto-install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only APIFY_TOKEN is required and is appropriate for calling Apify's API. The skill does not request unrelated credentials or config paths. Users should ensure the APIFY_TOKEN is scoped appropriately (least privilege) since it will be used to start actor runs and download datasets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent system-wide changes or modify other skills. It runs as-needed and only writes output files within the current directory as validated by the script.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it starts Apify actors and downloads results. Before installing, confirm you trust the Apify ecosystem and the source of the 'mcporter' npm package (verify package maintainer and consider pinning a version). Provide an APIFY_TOKEN with the minimum privileges needed (avoid a broad/or full-account token if possible). Be aware that scraping some sites may violate their terms of service or legal restrictions — only target data you are authorized to collect. Finally, note the tool will make network calls to api.apify.com and will report usage via a custom User-Agent string.
